bandReport.notes: RANGE DIFFERS FROM THE ASSIGNMENT. The brief predicted 'roughly items 26-45'; these four pages actually carry items 21-38. Trusting the pages as instructed. Layout is a clean 2-2-2 per column: p06 = 21,22,23 (c1) + 24,25 (c2); p07 = 26,27,28 (c1) + 29,30 (c2); p08 = 31,32 (c1) + 33,34 (c2); p09 = 35,36 (c1) + 37,38 (c2). Printed booklet pages 13, 15, 17, 19. Numbering is contiguous with no gaps and no repeats. Item 21 is whole at the top of p06-c1 and item 38 is whole at the foot of p09-c2 (followed by '[ P.T.O.'), so neither band edge is cut and no item spills past my pages. Whoever holds the neighbouring bands should confirm item 20 (ends before p06) and item 39 (starts after p09) — I did not see either. COLUMN CROPS: the automatic gutter split is correct on all four pages; every option block, statement list and left/right margin is intact in the c1/c2 crops, and I verified p08 against the whole-page image, which confirms the c1-then-c2 reading order (31,32 left; 33,34 right). The only crop artefact is cosmetic: the centred page number sits in the gutter, so it appears clipped or duplicated at the foot of both crops (e.g. '13' on p06-c1 and '3' on p06-c2). No question text is affected. SCAN SPECKS: item 24 statement 1 carries a small detached dot between 'It' and 'was' (raised, above the x-height). Zoomed to 2x on p06-c2 and confirmed it is a scanning speck, not printed punctuation; transcribed as 'It was'. Every page also shows faint Hindi show-through bleeding from the reverse side; it is not printed content on these pages and has been ignored. LINE-WRAP HYPHEN: item 37's pair table prints 'Chandra-' at the end of one line with 'ketugarh' indented on the next. Zoomed and confirmed this is ordinary wrap hyphenation inside the narrow first column, not a printed hyphen, so it is transcribed as the single word 'Chandraketugarh'. Item 37 is a genuine two-column matched-pair grid with an italic header row, so it is written as a GFM pipe table with the mandatory separator row; the item numbers 1-3 are kept inside the first cell because the options refer to them. Items 24, 25, 28, 30, 33, 34, 35 use 'Select the correct answer using the code given below.' as the final stem line, as printed. No defective questions, no duplicated option text, no unreadable items in this band.
